neighbours.label: ' of' after an abstract frame noun that names a system of norms or manners ('the ways of', 'the code of', 'conditions of', 'the rules of')
fire: The old fisherman taught the boy the ways of the sea.
Every prisoner quickly learns the code of the yard.
The samples were kept under strict conditions of temperature control.
Newcomers struggle to understand the customs of the village.
She explained the rules of the game to the visitors.
The monks preserved the traditions of their order for centuries.
He was raised in the ways of the old church.
Pilots must follow the procedures of the airline at all times.
quiet: The old fisherman gave the boy a bucket of fresh fish.
Every prisoner quickly gets a bowl of soup in the yard.
The samples were kept in a box of dry ice overnight.
Newcomers struggle to carry the bags of grain to the village.
She handed a cup of tea to each of the visitors.
The monks kept a jar of honey in their kitchen for centuries.
He was raised in a house of red brick near the church.
Pilots must carry a bottle of water on board at all times.

notes: Pole is broad (0.88% >0.1 max). Probe: 'ways of' 0.38, 'conditions of' 0.43, 'code of' 0.37, 'a point when' 0.61; 'a thing of beauty', 'place of your choice', 'method of her choosing' <0.06 (the negative pole's side: of + qualitative/possessive descriptor).
